title: Scalable long-range machine learning interatomic potentials with electrical response for atomistic material modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.23643v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate atomistic simulations of materials under electric fields require long-range electrostatics and electrical-response modeling at length scales beyond the reach of conventional first-principles methods. Yet these capabilities remain difficult to reconcile with the scalability of machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs). Strictly local models enable efficient spatial parallelization but neglect long-range interactions, whereas existing electrostatic extensions introduce global dependencies that hinder distributed computation. Here, we overcome this limitation by analytically separating the long-range electrostatic forces and Born effective charges (BECs) into a global electrostatics calculation and strictly local derivatives of learned latent charges. translated_title: 具备电响应的可扩展长程机器学习原子间势用于原子尺度材料建模
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.23643v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：对电场下材料进行精确的原子尺度模拟，需要在超越传统第一性原理方法适用尺度的长度尺度上建模长程静电相互作用和电响应。然而，这些能力至今难以与机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）的可扩展性相兼容。严格的局域模型虽然可以实现高效的空间并行化，却忽略了长程相互作用；而现有的静电扩展方法又引入了全局依赖，阻碍了分布式计算。本文通过解析地将长程静电力和玻恩有效电荷（BECs）分离为全局静电计算与学习到的潜电荷的严格局域导数，克服了这一限制。该表述在保持等变MLIPs空间可分解性的同时，能够对不同边界条件下的能量、力、应力和BECs进行分布式评估……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文通过解析分离全局静电计算与学习潜电荷的严格局域导数，构建了一种兼具长程静电与电响应建模能力、同时保持空间可分解性的可扩展机器学习原子间势，实现了电场下材料的分布式高效原子模拟。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a scalable machine learning interatomic potential that analytically separates global electrostatics from strictly local derivatives of learned latent charges, preserving spatial decomposability while enabling distributed simulation of long-range electrostatics and electrical response (including Born effective charges) in atomistic material modeling.
